svg.title: Since e−u = aN/ai this is the asserted decay Ci ≤A T(k, i)l(aN/ai)c with c = θ/2. It uses no continuum convergence. The general recurrence lemma, which also allows forcing at intermediate levels, is proved with all its steps in the scalar majorant paragraph above (constants K = 2(d+1)/θ, q = e−(θ/2) log 3, B = A/(1 −q) and the bound fi ≤B(K + 1)dτ d i ). Because the majorant is a scalar function of the realized scale clock and of the tagged terminal price, its lift is the identity on values: bCZ i = bCi, and the recovered kernel bound has the same constant C′ and exponent θ/2.
